caption: The drawing is done in graphite pencil on an off-white or light beige a sheet of paper. It features a single, full-length dress with a fitted bodice, a round neckline, and pronounced, puffed sleeves that taper at the cuffs. The waist is cinched with a horizontally pleated or gathered sash, and the skirt flows into two wide, full layers adorned at the base with two horizontal ruffled trims. In the upper right corner of the paper, there is a smaller, simplified outline of the same dress shown from the back, highlighting the puffed sleeves, the cinched waist and sash, and the skirt with its ruffled hem details. Handwritten text is present in the lower right corner, crediting the Federal Art Project and naming Mary Humes as the artist. The overall composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray from the graphite medium, with no use of additional color.
title: Wedding Dress
